projects.description:
Know Your Provider 4.0 - CA & NM StatesDescription, Key Features & Contributions
Description: The Know Your Provider (KYP) platform is acomprehensive solution designed for Medicaid provider enrollment andcompliance monitoring. The platform enables healthcare organizationsand government agencies to verify the credentials, licensing, andcompliance of Medicaid providers. The primary goal is to streamline theprovider enrollment process while ensuring continuous monitoring forregulatory compliance
Provider Enrollment Workflow: Developed and optimized the end-to-end Medicaid provider enrollment process, including data verification,document submission, and approval workflows
Global Search System: Integrated a high-performance global searchplatform across multiple applications, improving search efficiency anduser experience.
Messaging Infrastructure: Developed a robust messaging system withguaranteed delivery, supporting metadata for message integrity.
Performance Optimization: Enhanced backend performance, reducingresponse times by 30% and improving system efficiency
Caching & Data Integrity: Implemented caching strategies and dataintegrity solutions to maintain performance under high traffic
Collaborated with Portal teams from Bolivia, QA teams, and PMGteams to understand and exceed their expectations.
Developed a more efficient and user-friendly system.Full Stack Java Developer with 3 years of experience building robust,scalable web applications using Angular, Spring Boot, and MySQL.Proven ability to design and integrate RESTful APIs, optimize SQLqueries, and implement CI/CD pipelines for high-performancedeployments. Skilled in Agile methodologies, with hands-on experience insprint planning, code reviews, and cross-functional collaboration. Adept atsolving real-world technical challenges including global searchfunctionality, messaging systems, and performance tuning. Known fordelivering clean, maintainable code and driving continuous improvementacross systems and processes.
Dec 2022 - Present
